title: Update d/ch for 2.10-2ubuntu2 release
commit_message:
Update d/ch for 2.10-2ubuntu2 release

Disable ROSE support (HAVE_AFROSE/HAVE_HWROSE=0)
Linux 7.1 removed the amateur radio (hamradio) subsystem along with
its UAPI headers, so <linux/rose.h> no longer exists and rose.c fails
to compile (FTBFS in stonking with linux-libc-dev 7.3).

Mirrors the upstream fix merged in ecki/net-tools PR #70 (issue #69).
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index bce396e..d8eab0d 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,14 @@
+net-tools (2.10-2ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Disable ROSE support (HAVE_AFROSE/HAVE_HWROSE=0) in debian/config.h
+    and debian/config.make. Linux 7.1 removed the amateur radio
+    (hamradio) subsystem along with its UAPI headers, so <linux/rose.h>
+    no longer exists and rose.c fails to compile (FTBFS in stonking).
+    Mirrors the upstream fix merged in ecki/net-tools PR #70 (issue
+    #69).
+
+ -- Utkarsh Gupta <utkarsh@ubuntu.com>  Sun, 04 Oct 2026 17:58:21 +0530
+
 net-tools (2.10-2ubuntu1) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Merge with Debian unstable (LP: #2126010). Remaining changes:
diff --git a/debian/config.h b/debian/config.h

+++ b/debian/config.h

 #define HAVE_AFATALK 1
 #define HAVE_AFAX25 1
 #define HAVE_AFNETROM 1
-#define HAVE_AFROSE 1
+#define HAVE_AFROSE 0
 #define HAVE_AFX25 1

@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@
 #define HAVE_HWSTRIP 0

 #define HAVE_HWAX25 1
-#define HAVE_HWROSE 1
+#define HAVE_HWROSE 0
 #define HAVE_HWNETROM 1
 #define HAVE_HWX25 1
 #define HAVE_HWFR 1
diff --git a/debian/config.make b/debian/config.make
index 765bc52..15a7470 100644
--- a/debian/config.make
+++ b/debian/config.make
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ HAVE_AFIPX=1
 HAVE_AFATALK=1

 HAVE_AFNETROM=1
-HAVE_AFROSE=1
+HAVE_AFROSE=0
 HAVE_AFX25=1
 HAVE_AFECONET=1
 HAVE_AFDECnet=1
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@ HAVE_HWTUNNEL=1
 HAVE_HWSTRIP=0
 HAVE_HWTR=0
 HAVE_HWAX25=1
-HAVE_HWROSE=1
+HAVE_HWROSE=0
 HAVE_HWNETROM=1
 HAVE_HWX25=1
 HAVE_HWFR=1
